decisions.reason: Although its two-year absence from the website raises concern, its role as a strategically important reusable-harvest solution keeps it close enough to the firm's sustainability aspirations to justify continued support for now.

A foldable large-container line sits squarely in the firm's core transport-packaging business, so a large firm with some slack would usually keep it unless results clearly and persistently fall below aspiration levels.

Because this crate line was only lightly featured at launch and then not observed for two years, management would read that as likely underperformance versus aspirations and reallocate resources to stronger core offers or new development.

This pallet variant draws on existing capabilities but its sustained lack of visibility suggests limited traction, making withdrawal and redeployment of resources more attractive than further carrying it.
